newsitem.title: FINLAND: TURKISTUOTTAJAT AUCTION SALES FIM 360 MLN.
newsitem.headline: TURKISTUOTTAJAT AUCTION SALES FIM 360 MLN.

text.p: Finnish fur auctioneer Turkistuottajat Oy said in a statement on Wednesday that fur sales in its February auction totalled 360 million markka.
"In the February auction, there were over 330 foreign buyers and the turnover was 360 million markka," Turkistuottajat said.
The average price for Finnish mink was 164 markka, five to 10 percent lower compared to December's auction.
The average price for fox pelts was 408 markka. In an earlier statement this week, Turkistuottajat said fox pelt prices were down by 20 to 35 percent from last season.
The next Turkistuottajat auction will be held in March.
